nom: CeraVe Acne Control Gel Blemish Treatment

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the gel controls shine and helps with acne without leaving skin greasy, though a few say it can leave skin shiny or feeling stripped.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report it works well if paired with a moisturizer, though several note it is drying or stripping if used more than a few times a week.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it clears breakouts, especially in the T-zone, with mild dryness that is manageable with a light moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: Reports from sensitive skin are split: some describe no irritation and gentle daily use, while others describe burning, hives, redness, or swelling that led them to stop.
segments.mature: A small number of reviewers with mature or aging skin report it works well for acne without excessive dryness, alongside other anti-aging steps.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers using it alongside anti-aging routines report it did not worsen aging skin and worked well for adult breakouts.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say it can dry out skin if overused, especially more than a few times a week, but most say this is manageable with a moisturizer; some report no dryness at all.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers describe burning, redness, or swelling, particularly around the mouth or cheeks, sometimes worsening over time; others report no redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer explicitly notes that using it twice daily without following with moisturizer disrupted their skin barrier.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visible fading of dark spots and reduced blackheads over weeks of use; one reviewer saw no improvement in blackheads specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, including cystic and hormonal acne, within days to weeks; a notable minority report new or worsening breakouts, including cystic pimples and clogged pores.
concerns.oiliness: Several oily-skin reviewers report visible oil control and less shine over time, though one reviewer says it left skin looking shiny.

extraits.titre: I won't recommend this cleanser to anyone
extraits.texte: After 5 weeks of using this cleanser, it made my face worse. I started breaking out and having big acne, white head and blackheads which later turned into dark spots. I've never used any facial cleanser, I was recommended this cleanser to start using to clear blackheads but it made my face worse and really bad

I really wanted to love this face wash and I did. after using it twice it made my skin feel much more balanced and it didn't leave it oily either, but after the second time it burned my cheeks and left them swollen and red. It took about an hour for it to stop burning and for the red to go away. So this product works great but if you have sensitive skin just be careful and know what your skin is sensitive to.

extraits.titre: Works great for sensitive/combo acne prone skin
extraits.texte: My acne becomes a problem during the summer and i wear face makeup almost everyday. This is the one product that helped the most. I have sensitive/combination skin (very oily in t zone/dry everywhere else) It works best to use twice a day. I use it morning and night with no irritation. I double cleanse at night and i dont combine with any other acne treatments. The bottle lasts a long time even with everyday use and I've repurchased several times. However, I don't notice a difference in blackheads so I would recommend trying something else if thats what your problem is.

I've been using this for the past 2 years and my face has never been consistently this clear. My skin is completely smooth. I have very acne prone skin and I know it's effective because if I happen to skip a day and not use it, I get pimples. I have extremely oily skin and live in a humid climate and definitely notice that I don't look as shiny as I used to. I still get the occasional hormonal acne but even then it's not much and goes away quickly.

My skin is not prone to acne, but I do get a lot of small breakouts and pimples. This face wash cleared my skin like no other product has ever!!!!! It took a little bit of time to notice the results (maybe a month?) but ever since I've been using it, I have not experienced any breakouts or random spots. I have combo skin and it does dry my skin out a bit but not to the point that its stiff or uncomfortable - I just pair with a light moisturizer. My skin feels clean, but not stripped. Would totally recommend for anyone with mild acne. Love u cera ve

This cleanser has changed my skin! I always struggled with having consistently clear skin, once I started using this cleanser I never have breakouts anymore. I only use it at night and I have to follow it with the Cerave daily moisturizer for the full effect. I've noticed using it twice a day dries out my skin too much, and without moisturizer following it, it messes up my skin barrier. I highly reccomend.

when I found this I stopped looking for another face wash to control breakouts! You can't beat the price, I've spent $60 + on acne cleansers previously that didn't work as well. Isn't drying to your skin which is huge for me as I'm also dealing with aging skin.
